ext.description: Real-time Claude 5-hour session, 7-day weekly, and model-scoped (Fable) quota percentages with reset countdowns on the VS Code status bar.
cfg.title: Claude Quota Status Bar
cfg.language.desc: Display language for status bar labels and tooltip.
cfg.language.auto: Detect automatically from VS Code or system locale
cfg.showScoped.desc: Also show model-scoped weekly quota (e.g. Fable) directly on the status bar instead of tooltip only.
cfg.warningThreshold.desc: Usage percentage threshold to highlight the status bar with a warning color.
cfg.errorThreshold.desc: Usage percentage threshold to highlight the status bar with an error color.
cfg.refreshInterval.desc: Shared cache refresh interval in seconds across all open VS Code windows (minimum 30s to avoid HTTP 429).
